title: Decrement run under symbol complementation
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a word, let $i$ be one of the $k$ work-tape indices, let $d$ be a configuration of the increment machine on input $x$, and let $t$ be a natural number. Running the decrement machine for $t$ steps from $d$ gives the same configuration as complementing all work-tape symbols in $d$, running the increment machine for $t$ steps, and complementing all work-tape symbols in the result.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a work-tape index among the $k$ tapes
